text:
One nuclear reaction that occurs in the Sun is responsible for most of the energy released in
the Sun.
What is this nuclear reaction?
A
fission of helium to form hydrogen
B
fission of hydrogen to form helium
C
fusion of helium to form hydrogen
D
fusion of hydrogen to form helium

options.text: fission of helium to form hydrogen
